examples.text: Er zog näher zu seiner Arbeitsstelle, die Firma indes entließ ihn nach drei Monaten.
examples.translation: He moved closer to his workplace, the firm, however, fired him after three months.
examples.english: He moved closer to his workplace, the firm, however, fired him after three months.

examples.text: Ich lese morgens die Zeitung, indes trinke ich einen Tee.

examples.text: Er zog näher zu seiner Arbeitsstelle, indes die Firma ihn nach drei Monaten entlassen hat.
examples.translation: He moved closer to his place of work, and still the company sacked him three months later.
